recognize_zh: 左側大細胞核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質灰藍，為單核母細胞（monoblast）；右上一群細胞核有摺痕或扭曲分葉，細胞質豐富淡灰藍，為前單核球（promonocyte），兩者並存於周邊血液，提示急性單核球白血病。
features: Large immature cells with moderate to abundant grey-blue cytoplasm
Left cell with round to slightly irregular nucleus, fine chromatin and moderate cytoplasm (monoblast)
Right group: cells with folded/creased nuclei and a cell with convoluted lobulated nucleus (promonocytes)
Nearby small lymphocyte for size comparison and a segmented neutrophil at bottom center
Normocytic red cells with occasional echinocytes; no Auer rods seen
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating large immature monocytic cells. A cell on the left has a round nucleus with finely dispersed chromatin and moderate grey-blue cytoplasm consistent with a monoblast. A group on the right includes cells with folded or creased nuclei and one with a convoluted lobulated nucleus, delicate chromatin and abundant pale grey cytoplasm, consistent with promonocytes. A small lymphocyte and a segmented neutrophil are also present, and no Auer rods are identified. Findings are consistent with acute monocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: CMML shows predominantly mature monocytes with condensed chromatin and <20% blasts plus promonocytes, rather than monoblasts and promonocytes with fine chromatin.
Myeloblasts have scant cytoplasm, may contain Auer rods and granules and are MPO positive, while monoblasts have abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and are NSE positive.
Reactive lymphocytes have more condensed chromatin and cytoplasm that scallops around red cells, without folded delicate nuclei, and are CD3/CD8 positive rather than CD14/CD64 positive.
